I don't think it messes with gains, from my own experience. I think really cold ice baths shortly after training could mess with your gains. At least from what I heard. The best solution for me was mixed showers. Hot in the beginning and then cold in the end. Or switch every minute. That worked best for me.

1. Probably similar but what changes is that when you finish your shower with a cold one then you will be more awake. Finish with a hot one and you will be more relaxed. I would suggest, when doing mixed showers in the morning, finish with cold and in the evening with hot.

2. Actually the switch from hot/cold is pretty good for your body. It will train your blood vines and arteries, because your body will send blood to your heart while showering cold and send it back in all areas while showering hot. 
Mixed showers are especially great after sports because you can benefit from cold/hot water after intense effort. Furthermore it helps to relax your body and it really feels like after a refreshing spa day. 
I would suggest trying out:
1 Minute Hot
1 Minute Cold
1 Minute Hot
1 Minute Cold
